# 2 Baruch Chapter 68 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 68:3 — desecration of sacred vessels

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "made-the-holy-vessels-of-the-sanctuary into-impure-things" |
| LOGOS | "made the holy vessels of the sanctuary into impure things" |
| PNEUMA | "turned the holy vessels of the sanctuary into profane objects" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Impure things' (Syriac: tammin) is a cultic term of ritual impurity; PNEUMA's 'profane objects' conflates cultic impurity with secular defilement.

---

## 68:5 — holy things among the nations

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-were-added-to-the-abominations-of-the-nations" |
| LOGOS | "they were added to the abominations of the nations" |
| PNEUMA | "mixed in with the abominable things of the nations" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Added to' (Syriac: ettospu) preserves the sense of incorporation into a foreign collection; PNEUMA's 'mixed in with' is less precise.

---
